zh-TW.title: OpenAI 公布 Ironclad 代理評測
zh-TW.summary: OpenAI 與 Ironclad 以 11 項合約流程評測代理，每項含 8 至 50 個評分條件。任務包括保密協議、採購核准及依司法管轄區調整條款。GPT-6 Astra（Max）平均得分 55.0%，GPT-5.6 Sol（High）為 41.6%；估算每次耗時分別為 19.2 與 37 分鐘。OpenAI 註明時間按假設速度模擬，並非客戶實測節省。
zh-TW.takeaway: 評測涵蓋 11 項流程
zh-TW.caveat: 時間為模擬估算

en.title: OpenAI reports Ironclad agent results
en.summary: OpenAI and Ironclad evaluated 11 contracting workflows with 8–50 criteria each. Tasks cover nondisclosure agreements, procurement approvals and jurisdiction-dependent clauses. GPT-6 Astra (Max) averaged 55.0%, versus GPT-5.6 Sol (High) at 41.6%; estimated attempt times were 19.2 and 37 minutes. OpenAI says timings were simulated from assumed speeds, not measured customer savings.
en.takeaway: The evaluation covers 11 workflows
en.caveat: Timings are simulated estimates

zh-TW.title: Simon Willison 記錄 Codex 協助的 Datasette 追蹤整合
zh-TW.summary:
Simon Willison 在 10 月 6 日表示，他請 Codex 找出如何執行 Parseable 並接收 Datasette 的追蹤，再親自把可行的做法寫成筆記。

他的本機示範採用 Parseable 3.2.4 與 Datasette 1.0a41，使用本機儲存模式，設定匯出端點、服務名稱與資料串流。操作網頁後，Parseable 會顯示請求及其 SQL 查詢的追蹤；筆記另附替代連接埠設定。Parseable 預設使用 8000、8001、8002 埠；更換連接埠時，也須修改 Datasette 的匯出端點。

Datasette 更新紀錄顯示，OpenTelemetry 支援已於 9 月 24 日加入，涵蓋 HTTP 請求、資料庫查詢與啟動流程，並提供查詢延遲、寫入佇列等指標。官方文件說明，追蹤需透過 opentelemetry-instrument 啟動；直接執行 Datasette 不會產生遙測，預設批次處理器每五秒才匯出一次。文件另指出，未設定 OTEL_SERVICE_NAME 時，追蹤會歸在 unknown_service 名稱下；關閉程式時會送出最後一批資料。
zh-TW.takeaway: 筆記展示請求與 SQL 追蹤
zh-TW.caveat: 示範在作者本機執行

en.title: Simon Willison documents Codex-assisted Datasette tracing
en.summary:
On October 6, Simon Willison said he asked Codex to work out how to run Parseable and receive Datasette traces, then wrote the working instructions himself.

His local example uses Parseable 3.2.4 with Datasette 1.0a41, local storage, an exporter endpoint, a service name and a stream. After browsing Datasette, Parseable displays requests and their SQL-query traces; the notes also give alternate-port settings. Parseable defaults to ports 8000, 8001 and 8002; changing them also requires updating Datasette’s exporter endpoint.

Datasette’s changelog dates OpenTelemetry support to September 24, covering HTTP requests, database queries and startup, with metrics including query latency and write queues. Official documentation requires launching through opentelemetry-instrument: direct Datasette startup produces no telemetry, and the default batch processor exports every five seconds. The documentation adds that omitting OTEL_SERVICE_NAME files traces under unknown_service, and shutdown flushes the final batch.
en.takeaway: The notes show request and SQL traces
en.caveat: The example runs locally on the author’s machine

zh-TW.title: Atlassian 擴大與 OpenAI 的合作
zh-TW.summary:
Atlassian 與 OpenAI 於 10 月 6 日宣布擴大合作，讓 OpenAI 模型支援 Rovo 與 Atlassian 平台上的代理，並結合 Teamwork Graph 串連的人員、專案、文件及決策脈絡。OpenAI 表示，超過 3,000 名 Atlassian 開發者在終端、編輯器與程式碼審查中使用 Codex。這次協議延續自 2023 年開始的合作，擴大 Atlassian 取得 OpenAI 前沿模型的管道。

Atlassian 的公告把 MCP 連接企業脈絡列為現有能力；自主領取工作、執行測試、同步工作階段及多代理協作則列為仍在設計的方向，並保留人工檢查點。公告也把 DX 列為目前可觀察開發者影響的工具。文中描述以 Jira 記錄需求、代理進度與決策。

既有外掛說明列出兩項功能：在提示中選取 Jira 工作、Confluence 內容或人員，以及使用固定首頁接續工作。首頁整合指派的 Jira 工作、近期 Loom、專案及待審 Bitbucket 拉取請求；選取項目會開啟附有預填提示的新對話。該頁並說明，存取仍受使用者的 Atlassian 權限與組織控制約束。
zh-TW.takeaway: MCP 企業脈絡連接已可使用
zh-TW.caveat: 更深的自主代理整合仍在設計

en.title: Atlassian expands its OpenAI partnership
en.summary:
On October 6, Atlassian and OpenAI expanded their partnership to power agents in Rovo and Atlassian’s platform with OpenAI models and Teamwork Graph context connecting people, projects, documents and decisions. OpenAI reports that over 3,000 Atlassian developers use Codex in terminals, editors and code review. The agreement extends a collaboration begun in 2023 and expands Atlassian’s access to OpenAI frontier models.

Atlassian lists MCP-based enterprise context as available now; autonomous work pickup, test execution, session synchronization and multi-agent orchestration remain design plans with human checkpoints. The announcement also lists DX as a currently available tool for observing developer impact. It describes recording requirements, agent progress and decisions in Jira.

The existing plugin announcement describes selecting Jira work, Confluence content or people in prompts, plus a pinned Home for resuming work. Home gathers assigned Jira work, recent Looms, projects and Bitbucket pull requests awaiting review; selecting an item opens a conversation with a prefilled prompt. That page says access remains subject to the user’s Atlassian permissions and organizational controls.
en.takeaway: MCP-based enterprise context is available
en.caveat: Deeper autonomous-agent integrations remain in design

editionTitle.en: October 7 AI Daily: agent evaluation, open models and engineering practice

zh-TW.title: Anthropic 擴大資安驗證計畫
zh-TW.summary:
Anthropic 將 CVP 分成防禦、紅隊與特殊存取三層。防禦層涵蓋事件應變及漏洞分析；特殊層限獲准測試高風險安全系統的少數組織。公司以 Opus 5.5 對十個情境各測五次：防禦層攔阻 46 次；紅隊層未攔阻，完成 34 次。紅隊層目前限組織，僅能測試已獲授權的系統。

官方安全要求另規定，各存取層級須指定能處理安全與濫用警示的聯絡人，禁止共用登入，並啟用使用者設定檔，使請求可歸屬至具名使用者或工作負載。Anthropic 可持續要求符合安全規定的證據。涉及此存取權的疑似侵害或濫用須於 72 小時內通報 Anthropic；若屬安全事件，期限為 24 小時。
zh-TW.takeaway: 所有層級均有持續安全要求
zh-TW.caveat: 紅隊測試須有系統授權

en.title: Anthropic expands cyber verification
en.summary:
Anthropic divided CVP into Defense, Red Team and Specialized Access. Defense covers incident response and vulnerability analysis; Specialized Access is reserved for a limited set of organizations authorized to test high-risk safety systems. Its Opus 5.5 evaluation ran five attempts on ten scenarios: Defense blocked 46 trials; Red Team blocked none and completed 34. Red Team currently admits organizations only and permits testing solely on authorized systems.

Separate official security requirements mandate an actionable security contact, prohibit shared sign-ins and require enabled user profiles so requests are attributable to named users or workloads. Anthropic may request continuing evidence of compliance with those requirements. Suspected breaches or misuse involving CVP access must be reported to Anthropic within 72 hours, or within 24 hours for a security incident.
en.takeaway: Every tier has continuing security requirements
en.caveat: Red-team testing requires system authorization

zh-TW.title: Google 推出 EmbeddingGemma 2
zh-TW.summary:
Google 發布採 Apache 2.0 授權的 EmbeddingGemma 2；完整模型為 7.4 億參數，純文字配置為 2.7 億，另可選用視覺與音訊編碼器。公告列出 768 維輸出，可縮至 512、256 或 128 維。Google 報告，在 Pixel 11 Pro 上經量化後，純文字權重最低使用約 191MB 活躍 RAM，完整模型約 567MB。

官方產品頁說明，模型將文字、圖片、影片與音訊映射至共同嵌入空間，用於跨模態搜尋與 RAG 檢索，並有 8K token 上下文。頁面舉例以文字找圖片、以語音備忘錄尋找影片片段，並列出最長 5.5 分鐘音訊的處理範圍。
zh-TW.takeaway: 可選配視覺與音訊編碼器
zh-TW.caveat: 公告的記憶體數據採量化及指定硬體

en.title: Google launches EmbeddingGemma 2
en.summary:
Google released Apache-2.0 EmbeddingGemma 2 with 740M parameters, a 270M text-only configuration and optional vision and audio encoders. The announcement lists 768-dimensional output, reducible to 512, 256 or 128 dimensions. Google reports that quantized weights on Pixel 11 Pro use as little as roughly 191MB active RAM for text-only and 567MB for the full model.

The official product page describes a shared embedding space for text, images, video and audio, supporting cross-modal search and RAG retrieval with an 8K-token context. Its examples include finding images with text and video moments with voice memos; it lists audio inputs up to 5.5 minutes.
en.takeaway: Vision and audio encoders are optional
en.caveat: Published memory figures use quantization and specified hardware

zh-TW.title: Mistral Large 4 開放預覽
zh-TW.summary: Mistral 在 10 月 6 日的更新紀錄宣布，Large 4 已進入公開預覽。該頁將它描述為採混合專家架構的通用多模態模型，上下文為 100 萬 token，並註明開放權重尚待釋出。
zh-TW.takeaway: 目前提供公開預覽
zh-TW.caveat: 開放權重尚待釋出

en.title: Mistral Large 4 enters public preview
en.summary: Mistral’s October 6 changelog announces Large 4 in public preview. It describes a general-purpose multimodal mixture-of-experts model with a one-million-token context, while saying open weights are still forthcoming.
en.takeaway: Public preview is available
en.caveat: Open weights are forthcoming

editionTitle.en: October 7 AI Daily: agent evaluation, open models and engineering practice

zh-TW.title: OpenAI 公布數學成果與研究資料
zh-TW.summary:
OpenAI 公布內部模型產生的數學成果，包含多份 Lean 形式化、十份推理摘要、嘗試題目數及運算投入估計。公司表示，每項結果平均用量約等同 ChatGPT Pro 思考三小時的算力，並會繼續補上形式化資料。公告亦提供論文修訂與引用程序。

獨立諮詢小組 AGMAI 在同日聲明中表示，其角色不等於評斷成果影響，也不代表認可 OpenAI 產生成果的程序。小組認為，公開成果只是人類理解與納入數學知識的起點，相關評估應由數學社群進行。

AGMAI 於 9 月 29 日提出的建議要求，披露模型、提示、推理摘要、時間與估算運算成本，清楚說明形式化狀態，並交代問題如何選出及嘗試失敗的同等難度題目數。小組並主張，AI 實驗室應資助人類理解成果，但相關活動應由數學社群主導。
zh-TW.takeaway: 公告包含嘗試題目數與算力估計
zh-TW.caveat: AGMAI 諮詢角色不代表背書

en.title: OpenAI shares mathematical results and research details
en.summary:
OpenAI released internal-model mathematical results, including many Lean formalizations, ten reasoning summaries, attempted-problem counts and compute estimates. The company estimates average compute per result equivalent to roughly three hours of ChatGPT Pro thinking and plans further formalizations. The announcement also provides paper-revision and citation procedures.

In its same-day statement, independent advisory group AGMAI said its role neither judges the results’ impact nor endorses OpenAI’s production process. The group considers release the beginning of human understanding and incorporation into mathematical knowledge, with assessment belonging to the mathematical community.

AGMAI’s September 29 recommendations call for model, prompt, reasoning-summary, time and compute-cost disclosure, explicit formalization status, and explanations of problem selection and failed attempts at comparable problems. The group also advocates lab funding for human understanding while keeping those activities community-led.
en.takeaway: The release includes attempted-problem counts and compute estimates
en.caveat: AGMAI’s advisory role is not an endorsement

editionTitle.en: October 7 AI Daily: agent evaluation, open models and engineering practice

zh-TW.title: GitHub 推出 ReviewBench，評估 AI 程式碼審查的取捨
zh-TW.summary: GitHub 在 10 月 5 日公開 ReviewBench，讓 AI 程式碼審查有一套可重複比較的方法。它依真實 PR 的語言、儲存庫及變更規模分布設計評測，結合多來源標準答案與資深工程師驗證，並按問題嚴重度及精確率、召回率觀察表現。對採用多代理審查的團隊，這提供了分別衡量漏報與噪音的起點，也提醒我們不能只比較代理找出多少問題。要注意，這仍是離線評測；是否適合自己的程式庫，仍需用實際案例驗證。
zh-TW.takeaway: 比較漏報與噪音；採真實 PR 分布；仍需本地驗證。
zh-TW.caveat: 超過一億個 PR 指分布建模背景，不是 benchmark 測例數。

en.title: ReviewBench: An open benchmark for AI code review
en.summary: GitHub launched ReviewBench, a reproducible benchmark for AI code reviewers. It models real pull-request distributions and combines multiple sources of reference findings with engineer validation. Severity, precision, and recall help separate missed issues from noisy comments. For teams adopting review agents, it offers an evaluation starting point, but an offline result still needs validation against the team's own repositories.
en.takeaway: Measure missed findings and review noise separately.
en.caveat: The pull-request population informs distribution modeling, not the benchmark case count.

zh-TW.title: CodeMender v0.12.0 擴大掃描覆蓋，限制修補範圍
zh-TW.summary: Google 在 10 月 5 日更新 CodeMender 至 v0.12.0，新增隱藏檔掃描選項，並把預設檔案探索上限從 500 KB 提高至 2 MiB。修補代理也會限制與漏洞無關的持續整合、建置及設定檔修改；高信心漏洞回報要求具體可行的利用證據，並修正整段工作階段的 token 統計。對 AI 修補流程，重點是同時控制漏掃、越界修改與成本。隱藏檔掃描須主動啟用，公告也未量化誤報改善幅度。
zh-TW.takeaway: 提高掃描覆蓋；限制修補越界；修正成本統計。
zh-TW.caveat: 屬版本更新，並非整個 CodeMender 首次發布。

en.title: CodeMender updates (v0.12.0)
en.summary: Google released CodeMender v0.12.0 with optional hidden-file scanning and a larger default discovery limit, from 500 KB to 2 MiB. Fixes are constrained from making unrelated configuration changes, high-confidence findings require viable exploit evidence, and token accounting now covers the whole session. These changes address scan coverage, repair boundaries, and cost visibility; hidden-file scanning is opt-in and no quantified false-positive improvement was supplied.
en.takeaway: Evaluate scan coverage, repair boundaries and cost accounting together.
en.caveat: This is a version update, not the first CodeMender release; hidden-file scanning is opt-in.

editionTitle.en: October 6 AI Daily: code review, agent execution and voice systems

zh-TW.title: GitHub 加入 Lovable、Pydantic 與 Supabase 憑證偵測
zh-TW.summary: GitHub 於 10 月 5 日擴充秘密掃描，加入 Lovable API 金鑰、Pydantic 的觀測與 AI 閘道憑證，以及兩種 Supabase token。Lovable 同時加入合作計畫，公有儲存庫發現其憑證時，GitHub 會通知發行方處理。對使用 AI 快速搭建應用的團隊，這提醒開發者在原型轉正式服務前，檢查設定檔與程式碼中的憑證。不過，新增偵測不代表能找出所有秘密，也不能視為洩漏已自動修復；通報流程仍有適用範圍。
zh-TW.takeaway: 新增五種憑證型別；Lovable 加入合作通報；仍須處理實際洩漏。
zh-TW.caveat: 不要把每種新偵測器都描述成有發行方自動撤銷。

en.title: Secret scanning adds detectors for Lovable, Supabase, and more
en.summary: GitHub expanded secret scanning to cover Lovable API keys, Pydantic observability and AI Gateway credentials, and two Supabase token types. Lovable also joined the issuer-notification program for public repositories. The update is relevant when moving AI-built prototypes toward production, but additional detectors do not guarantee complete secret coverage or automatic remediation, and partner notifications apply only within their supported scope.
en.takeaway: Check credentials before moving AI-built prototypes into production.
en.caveat: New detection does not imply automatic revocation for every credential type.

zh-TW.title: Snowflake Cortex Agent 程式執行工具正式推出
zh-TW.summary: Snowflake 在 10 月 5 日宣布 Cortex Agent 內建程式執行工具進入正式提供階段。開發者在代理規格中啟用後，代理能依問題決定何時產生及執行腳本，用於資料處理、計算、視覺化，也能執行技能中的 Python。工具預設在隔離沙箱內運作，僅存取當前工作階段資料。對資料型 AI 應用，這是評估受管執行環境與自建沙箱的具體選項；但本次新進展是從預覽走向正式提供，不能當成首次推出，也不代表任何設定下都具有相同隔離條件。
zh-TW.takeaway: 從預覽進入正式提供；支援技能腳本；預設工作階段隔離。
zh-TW.caveat: 與 8 月的 Coding Agent 發布為不同功能事件。

en.title: October 5, 2026: Cortex Agent code execution tool (General availability)
en.summary: Snowflake made the Cortex Agent code execution tool generally available. Once enabled in an agent specification, it can execute generated scripts for data processing, calculations, visualizations, and Python-based skills. Default sandbox access is limited to current-session data. This offers a managed execution option for data agents, but the news is its move from preview to GA, and the default isolation description should not be generalized to every configuration.
en.takeaway: Compare managed execution with the isolation requirements of your data agents.
en.caveat: This follows the code-execution preview and is distinct from the August Coding Agent release.

editionTitle.en: October 6 AI Daily: code review, agent execution and voice systems

zh-TW.title: Nova 2.5 Sonic 與 Strands Bidi GA，強化即時語音代理
zh-TW.summary: AWS 於 10 月 5 日在 Bedrock 正式提供 Nova 2.5 Sonic，宣稱改善即時語音代理的推理、指令遵循、工具呼叫與延遲。同期正式推出的 Strands Bidi Agents 支援多家語音模型，記錄工作階段及工具呼叫追蹤，並能在背景重新連線以延長對話。對開發者，值得注意的是模型之外的可觀測性及連線管理，這些都影響長時間任務能否完成。效能改善仍屬供應商敘述，背景重連也不表示底層模型取消工作階段限制。
zh-TW.takeaway: 語音模型與框架同步更新；支援可觀測性；背景管理連線。
zh-TW.caveat: AWS 公告未提供改善幅度的量化 benchmark。

en.title: Announcing Amazon Nova 2.5 Sonic with improved reasoning for voice agents
en.summary: AWS launched Nova 2.5 Sonic in Bedrock, claiming improvements in reasoning, instruction following, tool use, and latency. The accompanying Strands Bidi Agents GA supports multiple voice-model providers, session and tool-call tracing, and background reconnection. For developers, observability and connection management matter alongside model quality. Performance claims remain vendor-reported, and reconnection does not remove the underlying model's session limit.
en.takeaway: Assess session recovery and observability alongside voice-model quality.
en.caveat: No quantified performance benchmark was supplied in the AWS announcement.

editionTitle.en: October 6 AI Daily: code review, agent execution and voice systems

zh-TW.title: OpenAI 開放部分 API 模型自選文字浮水印
zh-TW.summary: OpenAI 於 10 月 5 日宣布，全球 API 客戶可對部分模型自選文字浮水印，預設仍關閉；歐盟符合條件的 ChatGPT 與 Codex 文字輸出，則預計未來幾週逐步導入。偵測器開放申請，初期僅供獲核准研究者及專業組織使用。對整合生成式內容的開發者，這讓來源訊號成為產品設計的選項，但應區分已可申請的能力與尚未完成的部署。官方也強調短文及編輯會影響偵測，因此不能把結果當作作者身分，或是否使用 AI 的確定證明。
zh-TW.takeaway: API 自選且預設關閉；歐盟產品分階段部署；偵測具有誤判限制。
zh-TW.caveat: 產品公告摘要，非獨立法律解讀；也不是全球預設啟用。

en.title: Our approach to EU text provenance rules
en.summary: OpenAI opened optional text watermarking for selected API models, with the API default remaining off. Eligible ChatGPT and Codex text output in the EU is scheduled for rollout over coming weeks, while detector access initially requires approval. Developers should distinguish available opt-in controls from future deployment plans, and treat detection as a limited provenance signal rather than proof of authorship or definitive evidence of AI use.
en.takeaway: Separate available opt-in controls, planned rollout and detector limitations.
en.caveat: This is a product announcement, not independent legal advice or a global default-on rollout.

editionTitle.en: October 6 AI Daily: code review, agent execution and voice systems

zh-TW.title: ChatGPT 預告圖像廣告測試，擴充成效衡量工具
zh-TW.summary: OpenAI 於 10 月 5 日宣布新的 ChatGPT 圖像廣告格式，計畫本月稍後先在美國與少數廣告主測試，廣告會清楚標示，並與正在生成的圖片分開。公司同時擴充轉換資料、歸因與成效衡量合作，並與合作夥伴開發品牌適配評估試點。對打造 AI 產品的團隊，這顯示對話與生成介面正形成新的商業接觸點，評估時應分清曝光、歸因轉換與真正新增的效果。公告中的成效數字來自合作案例，不能推論所有廣告主都會獲得相同結果，新格式也尚未全面上線。
zh-TW.takeaway: 評估 AI 廣告時，分開看歸因數字、增量成效與實際投放範圍。
zh-TW.caveat: 新格式預計本月稍後在美國小規模測試；廣告主案例不是普遍成效保證。

en.title: ChatGPT plans visual-ad testing and expands measurement tools
en.summary: OpenAI announced a visual ad format for ChatGPT, with a limited US test planned for later this month. Ads will be labeled and remain separate from generated images. The company also expanded conversion-data and attribution integrations and is developing brand-suitability evaluation pilots. For AI product teams, the update illustrates new commercial touchpoints around generation; attributed conversions should be distinguished from incremental impact. Partner case studies are not a guarantee of results for every advertiser, and the new format is not yet broadly available.
en.takeaway: Separate attribution, incremental impact and rollout scope when evaluating AI advertising.
en.caveat: The new format is a planned limited US test. Reported partner results do not establish universal performance.

zh-TW.title: 代理更容易花錢，Simon Willison 主張預設硬性預算上限
zh-TW.summary: Willison 指出，代理讓付費 API 與雲端程式更容易上線，也放大失控支出的風險。他主張服務應預設在預算用盡時停止運作，並讓使用者明確選擇是否解除限制。
zh-TW.takeaway: 替代理設定每次任務與每月支出上限，實際驗證超額時會停止，而非只寄通知。
zh-TW.caveat: 這是實作者的產品設計主張；不代表所有雲端服務都已提供硬性上限。

en.title: Simon Willison argues for default hard spending limits
en.summary: Willison argues that agents make paid APIs and cloud services easier to deploy, increasing exposure to runaway usage. He advocates default spending limits that stop service at the budget ceiling, with an explicit choice required to remove them.
en.takeaway: Set per-task and monthly agent budgets, then test that exceeding them stops usage rather than merely sending alerts.
en.caveat: This is a practitioner’s design argument, not evidence that every provider already supports hard caps.

editionTitle.en: AI Weekly · October 4, 2026

zh-TW.title: Prime Inference 將開放模型推論服務推向正式應用
zh-TW.summary: Prime Intellect 發布 Prime Inference，提供無伺服器端點、預留容量與相容 OpenAI API 的介面。團隊說明跨資料中心故障轉移，以及如何用快取與排程支援長上下文代理流量。
zh-TW.takeaway: 試用時同時量測冷啟動、長對話延遲、工具呼叫正確率與故障恢復。
zh-TW.caveat: 速度與可靠度數字來自供應商；相容介面不保證所有既有工作流程可直接遷移。

en.title: Prime Inference opens its model-serving platform
en.summary: Prime Intellect launched Prime Inference with serverless endpoints, reserved capacity and an OpenAI-compatible interface. Its engineering account explains cross-datacenter failover, caching and scheduling for long-context agent traffic.
en.takeaway: Evaluate cold starts, long-session latency, tool-call correctness and failure recovery together.
en.caveat: Performance and reliability claims are vendor-reported; API compatibility does not guarantee a drop-in workflow migration.

editionTitle.en: AI Weekly · October 4, 2026

zh-TW.title: BootLoops 經驗：先選能驗證的問題，再讓 AI 跨領域探索
zh-TW.summary: 物理學家 Matthew Schwartz 分享 BootLoops：為代理提供可檢查的計算工具，探索跨領域問題。他強調，技術上正確的結果未必有研究價值，仍需要領域專家選題、檢查與引導。
zh-TW.takeaway: 把可重現的計算、可查閱的圖表與專家驗收列為不同檢查點。
zh-TW.caveat: 這是研究者的經驗文章；作者當時在 Anthropic 擔任訪問研究員，BootLoops 由他本人維護。

en.title: BootLoops pairs verifiable calculations with domain judgment
en.summary: Physicist Matthew Schwartz describes BootLoops, a harness that gives agents checkable computational tools for cross-domain research. His central lesson is that technically correct results can still lack scientific value; domain experts must guide the questions and inspect the conclusions.
en.takeaway: Separate reproducible calculations, inspectable plots and expert acceptance into distinct checks.
en.caveat: This is a first-person account. Schwartz was an Anthropic visiting researcher; BootLoops is his own project.

editionTitle.en: AI Weekly · October 4, 2026

zh-TW.title: OpenAI 披露七月推理擷取活動與防護措施
zh-TW.summary: OpenAI 表示已阻斷協同擷取模型推理內容的活動，並加強跨使用者與模型的保護。公司稱事件沒有直接存取已儲存的使用者對話；9 月文章披露的是 7 月觀察到的活動。
zh-TW.takeaway: 檢查可攜式代理狀態的權限與隔離邊界，勿將加密等同於可安全跨環境重用。
zh-TW.caveat: 事件範圍與防護成效依 OpenAI 披露，未獨立驗證；請勿把嘗試次數當成成功次數。

en.title: OpenAI reports reasoning-extraction activity and mitigations
en.summary: OpenAI reports disrupting coordinated attempts to extract protected model reasoning and strengthening protections across users and models. The company says the activity did not directly access stored user conversations. This September disclosure concerns activity observed in July.
en.takeaway: Review authorization and isolation around portable agent state; encryption alone does not establish safe reuse across environments.
en.caveat: Scope and mitigation claims come from OpenAI and were not independently verified; attempts are not successful extractions.

editionTitle.en: AI Weekly · October 4, 2026

zh-TW.title: GPT-6.1 Sol 降低代理工作流程的模型成本
zh-TW.summary: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6.1 Sol，強調程式開發、電腦操作與專業任務的能力／成本平衡。標準 API 每百萬輸入與輸出 token 分別為 2 與 10 美元，快取輸入為 0.10 美元。
zh-TW.takeaway: 用固定任務集比較成功率、延遲與每次成功成本，再決定模型路由。
zh-TW.caveat: 能力提升為供應商評測結果；價格與產品可用性以查核當時的官方公告為準。

en.title: GPT-6.1 Sol targets lower-cost agent workflows
en.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6.1 Sol for coding, computer use and professional tasks. Standard API prices are $2 per million input tokens, $10 per million output tokens and $0.10 per million cached input tokens; the company reports stronger performance than GPT-6 Sol.
en.takeaway: Compare success rates, latency and cost per successful task on a fixed workload before changing model routing.
en.caveat: Capability gains are vendor evaluations; pricing and availability reflect the official announcement checked for this issue.

editionTitle.en: AI Weekly · October 4, 2026

zh-TW.title: Sonnet 5.5 以更少 token 降低任務成本
zh-TW.summary: Anthropic 推出 Sonnet 5.5，稱輸出速度提升超過 30%，測試中每項任務最多便宜 30%。每百萬輸入／輸出 token 價格仍為 2／10 美元，成本改善主要來自較少 token 用量。
zh-TW.takeaway: 比較實際完成任務的總花費，並將推理強度與失敗重試算入。
zh-TW.caveat: 百分比為供應商測試結果，不能保證每種任務都同幅改善。

en.title: Sonnet 5.5 emphasizes efficiency at unchanged token prices
en.summary: Anthropic says Sonnet 5.5 generates output over 30% faster and costs up to 30% less per task in its tests. Input and output prices remain $2 and $10 per million tokens; the savings chiefly come from lower token usage.
en.takeaway: Compare total task-completion cost, including reasoning settings and retries.
en.caveat: The percentages are vendor test results, not guaranteed improvements for every workload.

editionTitle.en: AI Weekly · October 4, 2026

zh-TW.title: Holo4 讓同一代理切換畫面、程式碼與 API
zh-TW.summary: H Company 發布 27B dense 與 35B-A3B MoE 版 Holo4，可操作 GUI、執行程式碼並呼叫 MCP 或 API。團隊同時公開基準測試的執行軌跡，讓開發者檢視代理的實際步驟。
zh-TW.takeaway: 選一個需要跨畫面與 API 的流程，連同失敗恢復一起評估。
zh-TW.caveat: 官方比較使用的執行框架、題目子集與版本不同，不能視為完全同條件排名。

en.title: Holo4 brings screen and tool interactions into one model
en.summary: H Company released Holo4 in 27B dense and 35B-A3B MoE versions for GUI interaction, code execution, MCP and APIs. The team also publishes public-benchmark trajectories so developers can inspect the actions behind its reported scores.
en.takeaway: Evaluate a workflow that crosses screens and APIs, including recovery from failures.
en.caveat: The comparison uses differing harnesses, task subsets and releases, so it is not a fully controlled ranking.

editionTitle.en: AI Weekly · October 4, 2026

records.source: Cong Li, Hao Sun, Zenan Li and Zhendong Su / arXiv

zh-TW.title: Codoku 用可再生程式謎題評估代理推理
zh-TW.summary: Codoku 要求代理填入不完整程式，滿足整體靜態與動態限制，並可持續生成新題。作者以 300 題測試五個前沿模型，指出大型題目仍讓最強受測模型遭遇明顯困難。
zh-TW.takeaway: 在固定程式評測之外加入可更新、可驗證題目，降低記憶題庫的影響。
zh-TW.caveat: 這是預印本與特定程式謎題評測，不能直接代表真實開發產能。

en.title: Codoku offers renewable program-reasoning tests
en.summary: Codoku asks agents to fill incomplete programs under global static and dynamic constraints, with fresh puzzles generated on demand. The authors evaluated five frontier models on 300 puzzles and report that even proprietary models solved only about half of the large puzzles.
en.takeaway: Add renewable, verifiable tasks alongside fixed coding benchmarks to reduce dependence on memorized test sets.
en.caveat: This preprint tests specific program puzzles, not general software-development productivity.

editionTitle.en: AI Weekly · October 4, 2026

zh-TW.title: LEGO-Anything 揭示「能產出 3D 檔案」與「重建正確」的落差
zh-TW.summary: LEGO-Anything 讓代理從單張圖片反覆編寫與執行 Blender 程式。研究以 104 個場景的 208 張圖片分別量測檔案有效性、幾何與外觀，發現產出可用檔案仍不代表重建準確。
zh-TW.takeaway: 驗收生成作品時，分開檢查能否開啟、是否正確，以及是否符合視覺要求。
zh-TW.caveat: 這是預印本與模擬場景基準；作者也指出真實圖片上的表現仍落後專用視覺模型。

en.title: LEGO-Anything separates valid 3D artifacts from accurate scenes
en.summary: LEGO-Anything has coding agents iteratively write and execute Blender programs from single images. Its benchmark uses 208 images from 104 scenes and separates artifact validity, geometry and appearance, exposing a substantial gap between usable outputs and accurate reconstruction.
en.takeaway: Assess whether generated artifacts open, are correct and match visual requirements as separate criteria.
en.caveat: This is a preprint with a simulator-grounded benchmark; its natural-image results still trail specialist vision models.

editionTitle.en: AI Weekly · October 4, 2026

zh-TW.title: GitHub 分享以分階段 AI 稽核通報 24 個 Android 漏洞
zh-TW.summary: GitHub Security Lab 分享把稽核拆成入口辨識、弱點分類與驗證的流程，表示累計找到並通報 24 個 Android 應用程式漏洞。作者也說明模型會誤判影響與可利用性，需要驗證及研究者複核。
zh-TW.takeaway: 在已獲授權的程式庫測試分階段稽核，為驗證、人工複核與 token 消耗預留預算。
zh-TW.caveat: 這是團隊經驗報告，沒有證明任意專案都會有相同成果。

en.title: GitHub reports 24 Android flaws from staged AI audits
en.summary: GitHub Security Lab describes staged auditing workflows and reports finding and reporting 24 Android-app vulnerabilities. The account explains why models can misjudge impact or exploitability, and why validation and researcher review remain necessary.
en.takeaway: Try staged audits on authorized repositories, budgeting for validation, human review and token consumption.
en.caveat: This team report does not establish that other projects will achieve the same results.
